    The host chooses before everyone readies up.
    Controls & Poison Tag rules

    During a match: return to this same tab within 30 seconds after a connection hiccup. Your frog stays visible as OFFLINE while you reconnect.

    ↑↓←→
    POISON DART FROG
    Body contact spreads poison. Tongues don’t.

    WASD/Arrow keys + Space · Tap/release = jump; hold/release = charge. In air, hold = grapple; release = detach.
    Body contact only. GRACE cannot spread poison for 1 second.

    Rotate your device to landscape.Your session stays connected. The round continues while you rotate.

    Ready to hop?

    Move. Jump. Tongue.

    • WASD / Arrow keys: move + aim in 8 directions.
    • Space: tap/release to jump. Hold on the ground, then release for a charged jump.
    • In the air, press Space to fire your tongue.
    • Hold when attached to pull; release to detach and keep your momentum.
    • Left pad: move + aim in 8 directions.
    • Right JUMP button: tap/release to jump. Hold to charge; release to launch.
    • In the air, press the TONGUE button to fire.
    • Hold when attached to pull; release to detach and keep your momentum.

    Stay safe. Then join the chase.

    • One frog starts as Poison Dart Frog.
    • Frog bodies spread poison. Tongues never do.
    • Survive for 1 point/second + 2 points if you are last safe.
    • Poisoned? Transform for 1 second, then help tag the others.

    Everyone is Poison Dart Frog once per match. Highest total wins; ties share victory. Same-time last survivors each get the bonus.

    How to play Frog-Out

    Connection hiccup?

    During a match, we try to restore your frog for up to 30 seconds. Return to the same tab or refresh it; a new tab may not restore you. Your frog stays visible as OFFLINE and its score pauses. If the window expires, only your spot is removed; the room stays open.

    Leave this match?

    Leaving removes only your frog. The other players continue. If you are the tagger/freezer, the round advances; if only one player remains, they return to the lobby.

    Leave is permanent for this match. For a brief interruption, refresh or return to this same tab within 30 seconds instead.

    Game menu

    The match keeps running. Your frog stays in play while this menu is open.
